title: A/R Summary: a row shows one location's name or Multiple
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Make sure the organization has open documents at three locations, location A, location B and location C.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with open invoices only at location A.
  • Have a customer, customer B, with open invoices at location A and location B.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Location cell of customer A and customer B.
  2. Untick location B in the Location menu (leaving location A and location C).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A shows location A's name.
  • Customer B shows "Multiple".

Step 2:

  • The Location column stays (two locations ticked), and customer B's Location cell now shows location A's name: only its documents at the chosen locations count.
  • They are all at location A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S6-R4: “On A/R Summary and A/P Summary a row shows the location's name when all of that customer's or vendor's open documents at the chosen locations are at one location, otherwise "Multiple".”
  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”
